tool.name: associate_infobase
tool.description: Associate a project with an infobase (optionally as default)

tool.name: create_infobase
tool.description: Create a FILE infobase via 1cv8.exe and register it in 1C:EDT

tool.name: deploy_project
tool.description: Update infobase configuration from a project (sync project → infobase)

tool.name: get_infobase
tool.description: Get infobase details by name or uuid

tool.name: list_infobases
tool.description: List infobases registered in 1C:EDT (with optional folder/type filter)

tool.name: update_project_from_infobase
tool.description: Pull the infobase configuration into the project, replacing project content (background job)

tool.name: restore_infobase_from_dt
tool.description: Load a .dt into the project's infobase (replacing all data), then update the project and its extension projects from it (background job)

tool.name: update_extensions_from_cfe
tool.description: Load .cfe extensions into the project's infobase and update extension projects from it (background job)

tool.name: create_infobase_from_dt
tool.description: Create a new FILE/SERVER infobase from a .dt for a new project and update the project from it (background job)
